```{r build-mirna-inputs, include=FALSE}
mirna_sample_total <- sample_comp_view %>%
  filter(as.character(MainCategory) == "miRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_group_total <- mirna_sample_total %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("MainCategory") %>%
  left_join(group_clean_reads_tbl, by = "Group") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_detail <- output_all %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "miRNA", !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation), PrimaryAnnotation != "", PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_annotation_sample <- mirna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

mirna_annotation_group <- mirna_annotation_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
  left_join(
    mirna_annotation_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
      select(Group, PrimaryAnnotation, Percent),
    by = c("Group", "PrimaryAnnotation")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Percent = replace_na(Percent, 0))

mirna_levels <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(PrimaryAnnotation)

if (length(mirna_levels) == 0) {
  mirna_levels <- unique(as.character(mirna_annotation_group$PrimaryAnnotation))
}

mirna_palette <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(max(1, length(mirna_levels)), palette = "Set 3"), mirna_levels)
mirna_annotation_trend <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(PrimaryAnnotation %in% mirna_levels) %>%
  transmute(Group, TrendCategory = PrimaryAnnotation, Reads, Percent)

mirna_length_group <- group_length_view %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "miRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_sample_detection <- mirna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    DetectedMiRNAs = n_distinct(PrimaryAnnotation),
    MiRNAReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    MiRNAReadFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * MiRNAReads / CleanReads, 0),
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)
  )

mirna_feature_matrix <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  mirna_detail,
  feature_col = "PrimaryAnnotation",
  sample_order = as.character(sample_info$Sample),
  feature_order = mirna_levels,
  min_total = 0
)

mirna_correlation_tbl <- tibble()
if (nrow(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2 && ncol(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2) {
  mirna_cor <- cor(log2(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix + 1), method = "pearson")
  mirna_cor_order <- rownames(mirna_cor)
  if (nrow(mirna_cor) > 1) {
    mirna_cor_order <- rownames(mirna_cor)[hclust(as.dist(1 - mirna_cor), method = "complete")$order]
  }
  mirna_correlation_tbl <- expand.grid(sample_x = mirna_cor_order, sample_y = mirna_cor_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation <- as.vector(mirna_cor[mirna_cor_order, mirna_cor_order])
}

mirna_top_annotations <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(RPM > 0 | Reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = RPM, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

mirna_top_annotations_overall <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation)
```

```{r mirna-qc, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(mirna_correlation_tbl) > 0) {
  mirna_cor_values <- mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation[is.finite(mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation)]
  mirna_cor_min <- if (length(mirna_cor_values) > 0) min(mirna_cor_values) else 0
  if (!is.finite(mirna_cor_min) || mirna_cor_min >= 1) mirna_cor_min <- 0.95
  mirna_cor_plot <- ggplot(mirna_correlation_tbl, aes(sample_x, sample_y, fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), sprintf("%.2f", correlation), "")), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = mii_diverging_palette,
      limits = c(mirna_cor_min, 1),
      na.value = mii_neutral_line
    ) +
    labs(title = "Sample correlation from miRNA annotations", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    "04_sample_qc",
```

```{r mirna-target-helpers, include=FALSE}
first_existing_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hits <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    hits[[1]]
  }
}

write_tab_nested <- function(df, file_name) {
  out_path <- file.path(OUTPUT_TAB_DIR, file_name)
  dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_csv(df, out_path)
  invisible(out_path)
}

parse_ratio_value <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (!nzchar(x)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  parts <- strsplit(x, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) == 2) {
    numerator <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[[1]]))
    denominator <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[[2]]))
    if (is.finite(numerator) && is.finite(denominator) && denominator > 0) {
      return(numerator / denominator)
    }
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

build_enrichment_plot_df <- function(df, top_n = 15) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0 || !all(c("Description", "pvalue") %in% names(df))) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  plot_df <- as_tibble(df) %>%
    mutate(
      pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
      log10p = -log10(pmax(pvalue, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      count_value = if ("Count" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(Count) else NA_real_,
      ratio_value = if ("GeneRatio" %in% names(.)) vapply(GeneRatio, parse_ratio_value, numeric(1)) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(log10p)) %>%
    arrange(pvalue, desc(count_value)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      count_value = ifelse(is.finite(count_value), count_value, 0),
      ratio_value = ifelse(is.finite(ratio_value), ratio_value, count_value),
      Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description)))
    )

  plot_df
}

save_enrichment_bundle <- function(df, section, file_prefix, title_text, top_n = 15) {
  plot_df <- build_enrichment_plot_df(df, top_n = top_n)
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(title_text, "No significant terms passed the default pvalue filter."),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  bar_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Description, y = count_value, fill = log10p)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, alpha = 0.92) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = mii_enrichment_gradient) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = "-log10(pvalue)") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  dot_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = ratio_value, y = Description, size = count_value, color = log10p)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colours = mii_enrichment_gradient) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "Gene ratio", y = NULL, size = "Count", color = "-log10(pvalue)") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  save_plot_nested(
    bar_plot,
    section,
    paste0(file_prefix, "_bar.pdf"),
    width = 10,
    height = max(5.5, 0.34 * nrow(plot_df) + 2.2),
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    dot_plot,
    section,
    paste0(file_prefix, "_dot.pdf"),
    width = 10,
    height = max(5.5, 0.34 * nrow(plot_df) + 2.2),
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  invisible(plot_df)
}

run_target_ora <- function(target_gene_symbols, label, section, file_prefix) {
  target_gene_symbols <- unique(as.character(target_gene_symbols))
  target_gene_symbols <- target_gene_symbols[nzchar(target_gene_symbols)]

  if (!pkg_has("clusterProfiler") || !pkg_has(MIRNA_TARGET_ORGDB_PACKAGE)) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("miRNA target enrichment | ", label), paste0("clusterProfiler or ", MIRNA_TARGET_ORGDB_PACKAGE, " is not available; GO/KEGG enrichment skipped.")),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_dependency_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(list(
      gene_map = tibble(),
      go = tibble(),
      kegg = tibble()
    ))
  }

  orgdb <- get(MIRNA_TARGET_ORGDB_OBJECT, envir = asNamespace(MIRNA_TARGET_ORGDB_PACKAGE))

  if (length(target_gene_symbols) == 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("miRNA target enrichment | ", label), "No target genes were collected for this group."),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(list(
      gene_map = tibble(),
      go = tibble(),
      kegg = tibble()
    ))
  }

  gene_map <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      clusterProfiler::bitr(
        target_gene_symbols,
        fromType = "SYMBOL",
        toType = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID"),
        OrgDb = orgdb
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) tibble()
  )

  if (nrow(gene_map) == 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("miRNA target enrichment | ", label), "Target genes could not be mapped to Entrez IDs."),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(list(
      gene_map = gene_map,
      go = tibble(),
      kegg = tibble()
    ))
  }

  entrez_ids <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
  entrez_ids <- entrez_ids[!is.na(entrez_ids) & nzchar(entrez_ids)]

  if (length(entrez_ids) < 10) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("miRNA target enrichment | ", label), "Too few mapped Entrez IDs for stable GO/KEGG enrichment."),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(list(
      gene_map = gene_map,
      go = tibble(),
      kegg = tibble()
    ))
  }

  go_obj <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
      gene = entrez_ids,
      OrgDb = orgdb,
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      ont = "BP",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      readable = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  kegg_obj <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
      gene = entrez_ids,
      organism = KEGG_ORGANISM,
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  go_df <- if (is.null(go_obj)) tibble() else as.data.frame(go_obj)
  kegg_df <- if (is.null(kegg_obj)) tibble() else as.data.frame(kegg_obj)

  write_tab_nested(gene_map, file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_gene_map.csv")))
  write_tab_nested(go_df, file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_go_all.csv")))
  write_tab_nested(kegg_df, file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_kegg_all.csv")))

  if (nrow(go_df) > 0) {
    write_tab_nested(filter(go_df, p.adjust < 0.05), file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_go_fdr_lt_0_05.csv")))
    save_enrichment_bundle(
      filter(go_df, p.adjust < 0.05),
      file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label),
      paste0(file_prefix, "_go_bp"),
      paste0("GO BP target enrichment | ", label),
      top_n = 15
    )
  } else {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("GO BP target enrichment | ", label), "No GO BP terms passed the enrichment threshold."),
      file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label),
      paste0(file_prefix, "_go_bp_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }

  if (nrow(kegg_df) > 0) {
    write_tab_nested(filter(kegg_df, p.adjust < 0.05), file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_kegg_fdr_lt_0_05.csv")))
    save_enrichment_bundle(
      filter(kegg_df, p.adjust < 0.05),
      file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label),
      paste0(file_prefix, "_kegg"),
      paste0("KEGG target enrichment | ", label),
      top_n = 15
    )
  } else {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(paste0("KEGG target enrichment | ", label), "No KEGG terms passed the enrichment threshold."),
      file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label),
      paste0(file_prefix, "_kegg_note.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }

  list(
    gene_map = gene_map,
    go = go_df,
    kegg = kegg_df
  )
}
```

```{r mirna-target-load-miRNA-de-results, include=FALSE}
  mirna_target_sets <- list(mapping = tibble(), summary = tibble(), target_genes = tibble(), query_tokens = character(0))
} else {
  feature_col <- first_existing_col(de_mirna_results, c("Feature", "PrimaryAnnotation", "miRNA", "miRNA_id"))
  pvalue_col <- first_existing_col(de_mirna_results, c("PValue", "pvalue", "p_value"))
  significance_col <- first_existing_col(de_mirna_results, c("SignificanceMetric", "FDR", "padj", "qvalue", "PValue", "pvalue", "p_value"))
  logfc_col <- first_existing_col(de_mirna_results, c("logFC", "log2FoldChange", "LFC"))
  direction_col <- first_existing_col(de_mirna_results, c("direction", "Direction"))

  if (is.na(feature_col) || is.na(significance_col) || is.na(logfc_col)) {
    stop("DE miRNA results are missing the expected Feature/significance/logFC columns.")
  }
  if (is.na(pvalue_col)) pvalue_col <- significance_col

  significant_mirna_results <- de_mirna_results %>%
    mutate(
      miRNA_raw = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
      PValue = as.numeric(.data[[pvalue_col]]),
      SignificanceMetric = as.numeric(.data[[significance_col]]),
      SignificanceMethod = if ("SignificanceMethod" %in% names(.)) as.character(SignificanceMethod) else if (significance_col %in% c("FDR", "padj", "qvalue", "SignificanceMetric")) de_significance_label() else "PValue",
      logFC = as.numeric(.data[[logfc_col]]),
      direction = classify_de_direction(SignificanceMetric, logFC)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(miRNA_raw), nzchar(miRNA_raw), is.finite(SignificanceMetric), SignificanceMetric < 0.05, direction != "ns") %>%
    mutate(miRNA_token = normalize_mirna_name(miRNA_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(miRNA_token), nzchar(miRNA_token))

  mirna_input_summary <- significant_mirna_results %>%
    group_by(direction) %>%
    summarise(
      sig_miRNA_n = n(),
      median_logFC = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
      significance_method = unique(SignificanceMethod)[[1]],
      min_significance = min(SignificanceMetric, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_pvalue = min(PValue, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(direction, c("up", "down", "ns")))

  mirna_target_sets <- collect_mirna_target_sets(significant_mirna_results$miRNA_raw, species = MIRNA_SPECIES)
}

empty_target_mapping <- tibble(
  mirna_token = character(),
  target_gene = character()
)

extract_target_mapping <- function(mirna_tokens = NULL) {
  if (!is.data.frame(mirna_target_mapping) || !all(c("mirna_token", "target_gene") %in% names(mirna_target_mapping))) {
    return(empty_target_mapping)
  }

  mapping_tbl <- mirna_target_mapping %>% dplyr::select(mirna_token, target_gene)
  if (nrow(mapping_tbl) == 0) {
    return(empty_target_mapping)
  }

  if (is.null(mirna_tokens) || length(mirna_tokens) == 0) {
    return(mapping_tbl)
  }

  mapping_tbl %>% filter(mirna_token %in% mirna_tokens)
}

extract_target_genes <- function(mirna_tokens = NULL) {
  mapping_tbl <- extract_target_mapping(mirna_tokens)
  if (nrow(mapping_tbl) == 0) {
    character(0)
  } else {
    unique(mapping_tbl$target_gene)
  }
}

run_target_ora_checked <- function(group_name, target_gene_symbols, label, section, file_prefix) {
  broad_flag <- target_group_summary %>%
    filter(group == group_name) %>%
    pull(broad_uninformative)
  broad_flag <- length(broad_flag) > 0 && isTRUE(broad_flag[[1]])

  if (broad_flag) {
    skip_tbl <- tibble(
      group = group_name,
      status = "skipped",
      reason = "Target gene universe is broad/uninformative; GO/KEGG ORA is not reported as a main conclusion.",
      target_gene_n = length(unique(target_gene_symbols))
    )
    write_tab_nested(skip_tbl, file.path("07_target_enrichment/03_enrichment", label, paste0(file_prefix, "_ora_skipped_broad_target_universe.csv")))
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note(
        paste0("miRNA target enrichment | ", label),
        "Skipped because the target universe is close to genome-scale and would not be interpretable as a primary result."
      ),
      section,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_ora_skipped_broad_target_universe.pdf"),
      width = 8.6,
      height = 5.2,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
    return(invisible(list(gene_map = tibble(), go = tibble(), kegg = tibble())))
  }

  run_target_ora(target_gene_symbols = target_gene_symbols, label = label, section = section, file_prefix = file_prefix)
}
```

```{r mirna-isomir-helpers, include=FALSE}
parse_mirna_arm <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, regex("[-_](5p|5-p)$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "5p",
    str_detect(x, regex("[-_](3p|3-p)$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "3p",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  )
}

canonical_mirna_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace(x, regex("^[a-z]{2,3}-mir", ignore_case = TRUE), paste0(MIRNA_PREFIX, "-miR"))
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_", "-")
  x
}

    "Preferred miRNA/isomiR quantification from FASTQ when installed.",
    "Alternative executable name for miRge3.0."
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    status = if_else(available, "available", "not_available"),
    action = if_else(available, "Can be enabled with suitable inputs.", "SPORTS sequence-level proxy statistics are reported instead.")
  )
write_csv_safe(tool_status, "08_isomir/01_tool_status/isomir_tool_status.csv")
```

```{r mirna-isomir-sequence-isomir-proxy, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(mirna_rows) > 0) {
  mirna_sequence_variants <- mirna_rows %>%
    group_by(miRNA_clean, miRNA_token, arm, Sequence, Length, seed_2_8, first_base, last_base) %>%
    summarise(
      sample_n = n_distinct(Sample),
      total_reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_rpm = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(miRNA_clean) %>%
    mutate(
      total_mirna_reads = sum(total_reads, na.rm = TRUE),
      isoform_rank = row_number(desc(total_reads)),
      isoform_fraction = if_else(total_mirna_reads > 0, total_reads / total_mirna_reads, 0),
      dominant_length = Length[which.max(total_reads)],
      length_shift_from_dominant = Length - dominant_length,
      is_dominant_proxy = isoform_rank == 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(miRNA_clean, isoform_rank)

  mirna_isomir_summary <- mirna_sequence_variants %>%
    group_by(miRNA_clean, miRNA_token, arm) %>%
    summarise(
      sequence_variant_n = n(),
      seed_variant_n = n_distinct(seed_2_8, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_reads = sum(total_reads, na.rm = TRUE),
      dominant_sequence = Sequence[which.max(total_reads)],
      dominant_length = Length[which.max(total_reads)],
      dominant_fraction = max(isoform_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
      has_seed_shift_proxy = seed_variant_n > 1,
      has_length_shift_proxy = n_distinct(Length, na.rm = TRUE) > 1,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_reads), miRNA_clean)

  write_csv_safe(mirna_sequence_variants, "08_isomir/03_sequence_isomir_proxy/mirna_sequence_variants.csv")
  write_csv_safe(mirna_isomir_summary, "08_isomir/03_sequence_isomir_proxy/mirna_isomir_proxy_summary.csv")

  top_variant_plot_df <- mirna_isomir_summary %>%
    slice_max(total_reads, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(miRNA_clean = factor(miRNA_clean, levels = rev(miRNA_clean)))

  variant_plot <- ggplot(top_variant_plot_df, aes(x = miRNA_clean, y = sequence_variant_n, fill = dominant_fraction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = mii_enrichment_gradient, limits = c(0, 1), oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(title = "Top miRNA sequence-variant counts", x = NULL, y = "Sequence variants", fill = "Dominant fraction") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  save_plot_nested(variant_plot, "08_isomir/03_sequence_isomir_proxy", "top_mirna_sequence_variant_counts.pdf", width = 9, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  mirna_sequence_variants <- tibble()
  mirna_isomir_summary <- tibble()
  write_csv_safe(mirna_sequence_variants, "08_isomir/03_sequence_isomir_proxy/mirna_sequence_variants.csv")
  write_csv_safe(mirna_isomir_summary, "08_isomir/03_sequence_isomir_proxy/mirna_isomir_proxy_summary.csv")
}
```

```{r mirna-novel-feasibility, include=FALSE}
save_plot_nested(
  plot_note(
    "Novel miRNA / editing feasibility",
    paste0("Editing is disabled unless mismatch-aware alignments are supplied. Current MISMATCH=", mismatch_setting, ".")
  ),
  "09_novel_editing/01_feasibility",
  "novel_mirna_editing_feasibility_note.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r mirna-novel-novel-mirna-candidates, include=FALSE}
is_host_mapped <- str_detect(output_all$MatchGenome, regex("^(yes|true|1|match|match_genome)$", ignore_case = TRUE))
novel_candidate_sequences <- output_all %>%
  mutate(is_host_mapped = is_host_mapped) %>%
  filter(
    is_host_mapped,
    FeatureCategory == "other",
    PrimaryAnnotation == "NO_Annotation",
    Length >= 18,
    Length <= 25,
    !is.na(Sequence),
    Sequence != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sequence, Length) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
    GroupN = n_distinct(Group),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalReads), desc(SampleN)) %>%
  mutate(
    candidate_status = "sequence_proxy_only",
    limitation = "No hairpin, coordinate, or miRNA biogenesis evidence is available in this table."
  )

write_csv_safe(novel_candidate_sequences, "09_novel_editing/02_novel_mirna_candidates/novel_mirna_sequence_proxy_candidates.csv")

candidate_fasta <- file.path(OUTPUT_TAB_DIR, "09_novel_editing/02_novel_mirna_candidates", "novel_mirna_sequence_proxy_candidates.fasta")
dir.create(dirname(candidate_fasta), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (nrow(novel_candidate_sequences) > 0) {
  fasta_lines <- purrr::map2_chr(seq_len(nrow(novel_candidate_sequences)), novel_candidate_sequences$Sequence, function(i, seq) {
    paste0(">novel_proxy_", i, "|reads=", novel_candidate_sequences$TotalReads[[i]], "|sample_n=", novel_candidate_sequences$SampleN[[i]], "\n", seq)
  })
  writeLines(fasta_lines, candidate_fasta)
} else {
  writeLines(character(0), candidate_fasta)
}

if (nrow(novel_candidate_sequences) > 0) {
  novel_plot <- ggplot(novel_candidate_sequences, aes(x = Length, weight = TotalReads)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = mii_green, color = "white") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = paste0("Unannotated ", PROJECT_HOST_LABEL, "-mapped 18-25 nt candidate lengths"), x = "Length", y = "Read-weighted count") +
    mii_theme_bw()
  save_plot_nested(novel_plot, "09_novel_editing/02_novel_mirna_candidates", "novel_mirna_proxy_length_distribution.pdf", width = 8, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  save_plot_nested(plot_note("Novel miRNA candidates", paste0("No unannotated ", PROJECT_HOST_LABEL, "-mapped 18-25 nt sequences were available.")), "09_novel_editing/02_novel_mirna_candidates", "novel_candidate_note.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}
```

```{r mirna-novel-editing-audit, include=FALSE}
editing_audit <- tibble(
  check = c("Mismatch-aware SPORTS alignment", "BAM/SAM with mismatch information", "A-to-I candidate extraction", "strand/genomic-context filters"),
  status = c(
    if_else(mismatch_setting > 0, "possible", "not_available"),
    if_else(length(alignment_files) > 0, "available", "not_available"),
    "skipped",
    "skipped"
  ),
  reason = c(
    if_else(mismatch_setting > 0, "SPORTS mismatch setting permits mismatches.", "Current MISMATCH=0 removes mismatch evidence."),
    if_else(length(alignment_files) > 0, "Alignment files detected.", "No BAM/SAM files detected under sportsresult."),
    "Requires mismatch-aware alignment plus reference-base extraction.",
    "Requires genome coordinates and repeat/known SNP filters."
  )
)
write_csv_safe(editing_audit, "09_novel_editing/03_editing_audit/rna_editing_feasibility_audit.csv")

save_plot_nested(
  plot_note(
    "RNA editing audit",
    "A-to-I editing is not called from the current SPORTS tables. Generate mismatch-aware BAM before enabling this block."
  ),
  "09_novel_editing/03_editing_audit",
  "rna_editing_skipped_reason.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```
